i.norm: Verifies that the default escape character remains '$' after calling replace(String, int, int) on an interpolator-based substitutor. Steps: 1. Create a substitutor via the factory interpolator (supports many built-in lookups). 2. Obtain the substitutor's string representation to use as the source text. 3. Call replace() with an offset of '$' (36) and a length of 660 — both the offset and length are out of the meaningful range for the short toString() result, so no substitution is expected to take place. 4. Assert that the escape character is still '$', the default for StringSubstitutor.
Create a substitutor that supports environment/system-property lookups
Use the substitutor's own string representation as the source string
Call replace with offset='$' (36) and length=660; no in-range substitution occurs
The escape character must still be the default '$'
